description: Up to five coins related to one coin, each with its own dashboard: coins people name together with it first, then coins in the same category. Every row says why it is there. No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
